chunks: Abu Ali Al-Ash'ari, from Muhammad ibn Abd al-Jabbar, from Safwan ibn Yahya, from Dharih al-Muharibi, from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him), who said:
I asked him about the funeral (of the deceased), should the people be notified (proclaimed) about it? He said: Yes.

key_terms.أَبُو عَبْدِ اللَّهِ: A title for Imam Ja'far al-Sadiq (peace be upon him), the primary narrator in this chain.
key_terms.الْجِنَازَة: The funeral or the deceased body, often used metonymically for the death event and funeral rites.
key_terms.يُؤْذَنُ: To be notified or proclaimed; refers to the act of announcing news to the public.

ai.seo_question: What is the Islamic ruling on announcing a death to the community?
ai.summary: In this concise narration from *Al-Kafi*, Imam al-Sadiq (AS) confirms the permissibility of publicly announcing a death to facilitate communal participation in funeral rites. This ruling underscores the Islamic emphasis on collective mourning and social solidarity, ensuring that the community is aware to offer condolences and support the bereaved family.
